dialogues.speaker: Drahomira
dialogues.text: *sigh* Where in the world am I going to get this much Mora? There's no way I can scrounge up what's needed in this life or the next...

dialogues.speaker: Drahomira
dialogues.text: Umm... Please don't laugh. Here, look at this debt collection form. I don't ever remember borrowing so much... Someone must have used my identity to do it! And I don't know who it is!

dialogues.speaker: Drahomira
dialogues.text: And the deadline is right around the corner... there's no way I can pay it back...

dialogues.speaker: Drahomira
dialogues.text: First, this awful debt, and now there's an Agent lurking outside my house... How could things possibly get any worse?

dialogues.speaker: Drahomira
dialogues.text: Okay... Ugh, if only I had some time to make a decision...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe you should ask them about it.

dialogues.speaker: Drahomira
dialogues.text: Hmm? Yeah... I could do that, but if they just start demanding that I pay up...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like there've been some crossed wires here.

dialogues.speaker: Drahomira
dialogues.text: No way... I mean, look at that Agent over there. He's been staring for ages now...
